lead: `nvs run`'s entry point has a second caller, and nothing near it says so.
body: `run_run` in `crates/nvs-cli/src/main.rs` is also how `bundle::run` starts a bundled program, so a new parameter breaks a call site in `crates/nvs-cli/src/bundle.rs` that no anchor in the `Command::Run` region points at — and what to pass there is a decision rather than a mechanical fill-in. Grep `super::run_run` before changing that signature, and answer for the bundle first: nothing stands in front of it to have handed it anything, so its answer is almost always the absent one.
